items.name: Healing Tonic
items.description: Bitter as rust, but it closes wounds. Restores 12 HP.

items.name: Ember Shard
items.description: A sliver of living slag. Ember Bolt burns one.

items.name: Heavy Wrench
items.description: Two pounds of honest steel. Strike hits 3 harder.

items.name: Old Revolver
items.description: Rust on the barrel, oil on the cylinder. Unlocks Aimed Shot.

items.name: Leather Duster
items.description: Ash-stained and patched twice. Blocks 2 damage.

items.name: Foundry Key
items.description: Opens the east gate, and the road to the old foundry.

items.name: Machine Parts
items.description: Joss's stolen shipment: gears, springs, one cracked gauge.

items.name: Silver Locket
items.description: Tarnished. A tiny portrait of a woman inside.

items.name: Warden Core
items.description: Still warm. The Elder will want to see this.

items.name: Scrip
items.description: Paper money from a bank that no longer exists.
